::: typewriter
CROWN TELEVISION. AFTER HOURS HAUNTS. STILLS, WICKFOLD.
:::

::: handwriting
The chemist numbered the prints in his own order, not by time. I kept his numbers.

- Photo 1, 19 December, 10:20: our grey van in the factory yard, with the tower behind it.
- Photo 2, 20 December, 07:35: the typed note on Mrs Kessler's door. Every capital R in it has lost its tail and looks like a P.
- Photo 3, 20 December, 08:10: Mr Dunn at the gate hut, with his flask and his heavy boots.
- Photo 4, 20 December, 22:00: Rudy Platt in front of the tower, in his smooth town shoes, with his lucky gold tie pin in the shape of a television aerial on a dark red silk tie.
- Photo 5, 22 December, 10:40: a black car at the gate. A visitor for Mrs Kessler.
- Photo 6, 20 December, 17:45: red paint on our van that says GO HOME TV.
- Photo 7, 21 December, 22:05: the robot crates in the packing hall, stacked to the roof.

The paint on Photo 6 was still wet. Rudy made me take four more of it "for the papers".
:::
